title: Exact Git-blob hash domain for committed content seals
failure_signature: A working-tree-byte seal disagreed with 21 staged text blobs after Git newline normalization even though file-set, JSON, and privacy checks passed.
trigger_preconditions: manifest intended to attest committed bytes
candidate_workaround: Generate the committed-byte seal from exact Git blob bytes after repository attributes and clean filters, and name that domain explicitly.
recurrence_guard: Every hash receipt must declare Git-blob, normalized logical-text, or raw working-tree domain; staged parity may compare only the Git-blob domain.
rollback: Retain the mismatching review, restore the previous seal only as an explicitly raw-working-tree receipt if needed, and never relabel one hash domain as another.
scope_boundary: Committed-byte manifest portability only; no cryptographic signature, exhaustive integrity, security certification, or independent reproduction.
